Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried 
out every six months as indicated by M6 in the little block.
This pump function is to 
transfer water from feed water tank to low pressure evaporator then to feed 
water tank again.
The pump technical

Dismantling
Disconnect the motor 
electrically.
Isolate the pump ( Close the isolating valves ) and drain it as completely as 
possible.
Disconnect the 
auxiliary piping (water cooling).
Uncoupling pump from 
motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as pressure and temperature 
measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from 
suction and discharge piping.
Remove coupling spacer
Drain the oil.
Remove the casing 
adapter frame nuts.
Pull out the complete 
bearing housing with rotor.
Carry the complete 
bearing housing with rotor eventually to the workshop to continue dismantling.
